title: Read unread Slack channel messages with AI
h1: catch up on unread slack posts without posting a reply
description: Get a private AI catch-up from unread Slack channel posts. Know whose read marker is used, why thread replies are missing and when more pages are needed.
keywords: claude slack unread channel catch up
answer: **catch up privately before you jump into the channel.** the bot reads unread slack posts and tells you what needs attention here. unread follows your connected account's reading position. read only is enough. this list leaves out thread replies, and starts at the oldest posts if slack has no saved reading position.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: a private catch-up from unread posts.
what:
**get back from lunch knowing what needs you.** unread follows your slack account's reading position, rather than the bot's memory. name the channel and let the bot find it. your connected account must belong to that channel, private channel or group dm.

have the bot continue through to the newest post. thread replies need a separate read; someone may already have answered the question there.
uses: catch unread duty-channel announcements after lunch
skim the group conversation before the evening shift
pull out questions from status posts without replying to anyone

routine.message: every weekday at 13:35, read unread main-channel posts in greywick duty through my connected slack account. finish all result batches. group questions, notices and other updates here. say clearly that you have not checked thread replies. if no posts are unread, say so in one line. never post, react or change my reading position.
routine.needs: slack read only; your connected account belongs to the duty channel
routine.output:
greywick duty: unread channel posts
questions: soren asked who has the spare gate key.
notices: east entrance closed for cleaning.
updates: evening rota shared.
thread replies still to read.

steps: connect the slack account whose unread position you want; allow **read only**
name the channel and have the bot find it
try one catch-up and open the threads behind questions that need you
read the next run on the schedule card; pause lunchtime catch-ups during leave
watch: **channel posts leave out thread replies.** fetch the relevant threads before treating a question as unanswered.
**no saved reading position can bring old posts back.** ask the bot to flag that gap.
**the default batch holds 25 posts.** the bot should continue until it finishes.
**sleep stops local catch-ups.** dusk cloud keeps the scheduled routine running.

faq.q: does the summary include unread thread replies?
faq.a: **not with this action alone.** ask for a separate thread read when a post needs more context.

faq.q: why do i see posts i already remember reading?
faq.a: **slack starts at the oldest posts without a saved reading position.** use the account whose unread dots you want and have the bot flag when that position is missing.

steps: name one channel you belong to
ask for unread posts grouped by what needs you
read threads before acting on open questions

mistakes.fix: read its thread before chasing someone.
connect the account whose unread dots you want

tip.text: the channel asks the question. the thread may already have the answer.
